The heater now has a half-degree dead band either side of the target, and replaying last night's log gives 2 relay switches instead of 12. It comes on once at 04:26 (19.3°C) and goes off once at 04:40 (20.6°C).

The setting is `HYSTERESIS_C = 0.5`, directly under `TARGET_C` in `greenhouse.py`. The heater turns on at or below 19.5°C and off at or above 20.5°C; in between it keeps whatever state it was already in.

- **Startup:** the relay starts off, so if the script starts with the temperature already inside the band (say 19.7°C), the heater stays off until it drops to 19.5°C.
- **The Pi:** I only changed and ran this replay script. `heater_on` now takes the current relay state as a second argument, so if the controller on the Pi has its own copy of the code or calls that function, it needs the same change.
